parsed.name: 配方规则组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于定义并准备实验数据处理中的配方规则。它服务于集群或笔记本环境下的任务启动、组织与进度跟踪，而不是直接控制任何实验硬件。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used to define and prepare recipe rules in experimental data-processing workflows. It supports task launching, organization, and progress tracking in cluster or notebook environments rather than directly controlling laboratory hardware.

actions.description: 准备该配方规则以供执行。
actions.description_en: Prepare the recipe rule for execution.
